title: Ansible Automation Engineer
description:
Senior Ansible Automation Engineer (Windows/Linux)

Location: Remote in LATAM – Brazil (Work primarily in local time zone with overlap across US, India, and UK teams)

Duration: 6 months (possible extensions)


Responsibilities

We are seeking a Senior Ansible Automation Engineer to support enterprise automation initiatives using Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) and Event Driven Ansible (EDA). This role focuses on enhancing and migrating automation use cases across Windows and Linux environments, with a strong emphasis on Windows.


Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Ansible Playbooks, Workflows, and Event?Driven automations

Analyze and migrate existing Windows/Linux automation workflows into Ansible-based solutions

Automate operational tasks including patching, compliance, configuration, and observability

Integrate Ansible with enterprise tools such as ServiceNow, Splunk, VMware, and external databases (SQL/Oracle)

Build and maintain custom Ansible modules and collections (Python-based)

Collaborate with global, cross-functional teams and contribute to a backlog-driven automation model

Produce documentation and support knowledge transfer activities


Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Ansible Automation Platform (AAP)
  • Working knowledge of Event Driven Ansible (EDA)
  • Advanced Ansible Playbook development for Windows and Linux
  • Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash; strong YAML/JSON skills
  • Experience in integrating automations with APIs and external data sources
  • Familiarity with GitHub and CI/CD concepts

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Back end - Java + AWS
description:
Código da vaga: 59213


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional de Desenvolvedor Java- venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência sólida com Java (8+) e Spring Boot
  • Vivência com arquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS)
  • Experiência com EKS (Kubernetes)
  • Conhecimento em serviços AWS: S3, Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS)
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares)
  • Experiência com CI/CD (preferencialmente GitHub Actions )
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST e microsserviços
  • Experiência com IA



Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend utilizando Java e Spring Boot

Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful escaláveis

Atuar com arquitetura de microsserviços

Trabalhar com serviços AWS como EKS, S3, Lambda e API Gateway

Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código (IaC )

Criar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD com GitHub Actions

Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento (clean code, testes, segurança)

Atuar em conjunto com times de DevOps e arquitetura


Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: L3 Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Support Engineer (Linux / Kubernetes / OpenShift / OpenStack)

Location: Remote


Job Summary:

Looking for an L3 Support Engineer with strong expertise in Linux and hands-on experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack . This role focuses on advanced troubleshooting, system stability, and supporting critical infrastructure in a fast-paced production environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide L3 production support for Linux-based systems and cloud/container platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack environments.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes for recurring incidents.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, and reliability, ensuring minimal downtime .
  • Collaborate with L1/L2 support, DevOps, and engineering teams for issue resolution and improvements.
  • Support incident management, problem management, and change management processes.
  • Work on patching, upgrades, and system maintenance activities.
  • Automate repetitive tasks using shell scripting or other tools .
  • Maintain documentation for issues, solutions, and system configurations .

Required Skills:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Linux (mandatory) .
  • Experience with Kubernetes (deployment, troubleshooting, cluster management).
  • Working knowledge of OpenShift and OpenStack platforms.
  • Experience in production support (L3 level) with incident handling.
  • Good understanding of networking, storage, and system performance tuning .
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools and log analysis .
  • Scripting experience (Bash/Shell/Python is a plus).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP) .
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices .
  • Certifications in Linux, Kubernetes, or OpenStack are a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Ability to work under pressure in critical production environments .
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO


Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.



Requisitos


  • Possuir a certificação ANCORD ativa (indispensável);
  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;
  • Ter interesse em prospectar potenciais investidores;
  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.



Modelo de Contratação


  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.



Etapas de Seleção


  • Entrevista com o Recrutamento e seleção;
  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Remoto
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Gerente de projetos
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Gerente de Projetos nível Pleno (remoto)

Responsabilidades:

-Gerenciar o portfólio de projetos, garantindo a entrega dentro dos prazos, custos e padrões de qualidade definidos.

-Desenvolver e implementar metodologias de governança e gestão de projetos.

-Realizar análises de riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação.

-Atuar como facilitador entre stakeholders internos e externos, garantindo a comunicação eficaz e a tomada de decisão orientada por dados.

-Monitorar indicadores de desempenho e preparar relatórios executivos para Gestores.

-Apoiar na transformação digital e na implementação de soluções inovadoras para otimização de processo


Requisitos:

-Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos e PMO em conglomerados financeiros.

-Conhecimento avançado de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

-Expertise em sistemas financeiros, regulatórios e compliance bancário.

-Habilidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.

-Capacidade de liderança e influência em ambientes corporativos dinâmicos


Diferenciais:

-Certificações PMP, SAFe ou similares.-Experiência com gestão de projetos de transformação digital em Bancos.

-Conhecimento de ferramentas de gestão como Jira, MS Project e Power BI


100% REMOTA

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Senior Full Stack Developer com forte atuação em backend e experiência em contextos de pagamentos para compor o time de tecnologia.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando ReactJS e APIs RESTful, com forte atuação em backend utilizando Node.js e Express, principalmente em soluções relacionadas ao contexto de pagamentos;
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de tecnologia (Engenharia, Produto e Design) para o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Backend e Frontend, com maior profundidade em backend;
  • Experiência em Typescript e API REST;
  • Experiência ou vivência com integrações e contextos de pagamentos (gateways, billing, recorrência, webhooks ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Conhecimento em Styled Components e Context API;
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Também será responsável pelo atendimento a doadores, cadastro, orientação e suporte técnico em procedimentos de transfusão. Este é um cargo de tempo integral, com atuação presencial.
Qualificações
  • Procedimentos em Hemoterapia: Experiência em coleta, análise e processamento de hemocomponentes, além de desenvolvimento de protocolos de qualidade em hemoterapia.
  • Competências Técnicas: Conhecimento em técnicas laboratoriais, manuseio de equipamentos específicos e controle de qualidade.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Habilidade para realizar atendimento humanizado aos doadores de sangue com clareza e empatia, assegurando uma experiência positiva.
  • Formação técnica em hemoterapia, biomedicina ou áreas correlatas. Registro ativo no conselho profissional correspondente será considerado um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em normas regulamentadoras e boas práticas em laboratórios será altamente valorizado.

title: SR Desenvolvimento React Native + IA
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor React Native que não apenas construa interfaces, mas que entenda como integrar Inteligência Artificial no core do produto. O candidato ideal é um engenheiro \"AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript.
  • Integração de IA: Implementar funcionalidades que consomem LLMs, gerenciam estado de conversação e integram ferramentas externas via MCP.
  • Fluxo AI-First: Utilizar o editor Cursor como IDE principal, dominando a composição de contextos, regras de projeto (.cursorrules) e automação de refatoração.
  • Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código.
  • Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar \"Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar).
  • Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.


Requisitos

  • React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated).
  • TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada.
  • Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules).
  • Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar).
  • Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API.
  • Produto: Capacidade de ler e questionar PRDs, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: LatAm Business Development（web3/CEX）
description:
Business Development – América Latina

Responsabilidades

  • Desarrollar estrategias de crecimiento para el mercado latinoamericano
  • Onboard de KOLs, comunidades y partners locales
  • Impulsar adquisición de usuarios y volumen de trading
  • Construir relaciones a largo plazo con socios estratégicos
  • Monitorear métricas clave y desempeño del canal
  • Analizar tendencias del mercado y competencia

Requisitos

  • 1–3 años de experiencia en BD / ventas / partnerships
  • Experiencia en crypto es altamente valorada
  • Red de contactos en el ecosistema cripto es un plus
  • Perfil orientado a resultados
  • Español nativo; inglés es un diferencial


Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute business development strategies across Latin America (Brazil / Argentina / Mexico / Colombia, etc.)
  • Identify and onboard local KOLs, communities, affiliates, trading groups, and channel partners
  • Drive user acquisition and increase trading volume in the region
  • Establish and maintain long-term relationships with key partners
  • Track BD performance metrics (new users, active traders, trading volume, channel ROI)
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activities and provide insights to internal teams
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Operations teams to improve local growth strategy

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in BD / Sales / Partnerships (crypto experience preferred)
  • Strong understanding of the LatAm crypto ecosystem
  • Existing network of KOLs / communities is a strong plus
  • Result-oriented with strong execution ability
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Compensation

  • Competitive base salary
  • Performance-based commission (linked to trading volume / KOL performance)
  • Flexible remote work
  • Fast growth opportunity in a global crypto exchange

  • Onboard de KOLs, comunidades y partners locales
  • Impulsar adquisición de usuarios y volumen de trading
  • Construir relaciones a largo plazo con socios estratégicos
  • Monitorear métricas clave y desempeño del canal
  • Analizar tendencias del mercado y competencia

Requisitos

  • 1–3 años de experiencia en BD / ventas / partnerships
  • Experiencia en crypto es altamente valorada
  • Red de contactos en el ecosistema cripto es un plus
  • Perfil orientado a resultados
  • Español nativo; inglés es un diferencial


Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute business development strategies across Latin America (Brazil / Argentina / Mexico / Colombia, etc.)
  • Identify and onboard local KOLs, communities, affiliates, trading groups, and channel partners
  • Drive user acquisition and increase trading volume in the region
  • Establish and maintain long-term relationships with key partners
  • Track BD performance metrics (new users, active traders, trading volume, channel ROI)
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activities and provide insights to internal teams
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Operations teams to improve local growth strategy

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in BD / Sales / Partnerships (crypto experience preferred)
  • Strong understanding of the LatAm crypto ecosystem
  • Existing network of KOLs / communities is a strong plus
  • Result-oriented with strong execution ability
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Compensation

  • Competitive base salary
  • Performance-based commission (linked to trading volume / KOL performance)
  • Flexible remote work
  • Fast growth opportunity in a global crypto exchange

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Controlador de Acesso
description:
Estamos em busca de profissionais atentos, cordiais e proativos para integrar nossa equipe de monitoramento e recepção em empreendimentos residenciais de médio e alto padrão na Zona Leste de São Paulo . Se você preza pela organização, segurança e pelo atendimento de excelência, essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Gestão de Fluxo: Controle rigoroso de entrada e saída de moradores, colaboradores, visitantes e prestadores de serviços, seguindo as normas de segurança sem exceções.
  • Identificação e Cadastro: Registro de dados em sistemas informatizados ou planilhas, com verificação de documentos de forma respeitosa e ágil.
  • Recebimento de Mercadorias: Protocolar encomendas e correspondências, notificando os destinatários conforme os procedimentos internos.
  • Atendimento e Orientação: Prestar informações com postura empática, neutra e profissional, garantindo um ambiente seguro e acolhedor.


Qualificações Necessárias


  • Escolaridade: Ensino Médio completo.
  • Experiência: Vivência anterior como controlador(a) de acesso, porteiro(a) ou em atendimento ao público (será um diferencial).
  • Habilidades: Excelente comunicação verbal, capacidade de mediação de conflitos e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Localização: Ter fácil acesso às regiões da Zona Leste (São Paulo) .
  • Certificações (Desejável): Curso de formação em Controladoria de Acesso ou Segurança Patrimonial atualizado.


Remuneração e Benefícios


  • Salário: R$ 2.162,60
  • Vale Refeição (VR): R$ 21,80 por dia.
  • Cesta Básica: R$ 151,91 + Cesta Básica II de R$ 315,00.
  • Saúde: Plano Odontológico Bradesco (sem custo para o colaborador).
  • PLR: Participação nos Lucros e Resultados paga 2x ao ano.
  • Bem-estar e Lazer: Parcerias com SESC e descontos exclusivos em parques (Hopi Hari, Wet 'n Wild, Neogeo, Jump’n Joy, Parque da Mônica e outros).


⏰ Jornada e Condições
  • Escala: 12x36.
  • Horários: 06h00 às 18h00 ou 18h00 às 06h00.
  • Contratação: Oportunidade Efetiva (CLT) para início imediato.
  • ⚠️ Importante: Não trabalhamos com conciliação de horários.

title: Project Manager and Analyst
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a high-impact Project Manager & Analyst who thrives at the intersection of data-driven insights and operational excellence.

You will be the driving engine of our project executions, responsible for translating complex data into actionable project plans and managing relevant stakeholder, client, and executive communications.


Key Responsibilities


1. Project Management

  • End-to-End Oversight: Lead cross-functional projects from initial scoping through to final delivery, ensuring timelines and quality benchmarks are met.
  • Process Optimization: Identify bottlenecks in our current workflows and design scalable solutions to improve efficiency across the organization. Author standard operating procedures (SOPs) and forms.
  • Resource Allocation: Monitor project health and adjust resources dynamically to meet shifting business priorities.


2. Data Analysis & Insights

  • Analytical Rigor: Synthesize large datasets to identify trends, track KPIs, and provide insights that influence company growth.
  • Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that provide real-time visibility into project performance and departmental goals.
  • Risk Mitigation: Use quality management systems and predictive analysis to identify potential project risks before they impact the bottom line.


3. Executive Communication

  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary bridge between clients, technical, operations teams and the executive suite.
  • Presentations: Craft compelling narratives and slide decks for leadership meetings, distilling complex project statuses into clear, high-level summaries.
  • Alignment: Ensure all project goals are tightly aligned with Medcase’s overarching commercial and clinical objectives.


Who You Are

  • A Master of Organization: You use project management principles, like Agile methodologies and tools to optimize processes.
  • Analytically Minded: You are comfortable with SQL, Google Sheets, AppScript, Looker Studio and possess a natural curiosity to dig into the \"why\" behind the numbers.
  • An Exceptional Communicator: You know how to be concise, persuasive, and professional. Present your ideas and insights using storytelling and with ease.
  • Proactive: You don't wait for a roadmap; you help build it.


Qualifications


Experience

3–5 years in Project Management, Business Analysis, or Management Consulting. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating across time zones. Strong proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required.


PMP certification is a strong plus.


Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Healthcare Admin, Health Tech or a related field.


Tech Stack

Proficiency in PM software (Slack, Notion), CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot/Odoo), and BI tools (Tableau/PowerBI/Looker Studio). Agile tools / methodologies.


Industry

Experience in HealthTech or SaaS is highly preferred. Familiarity with healthcare terminology or AI/data projects is a plus.


Why Medcase?

Medcase is a supplier of global clinician expertise to the world’s leading healthcare AI organizations. We operate to streamline the human in the loop service for data curation and AI training. You will be working alongside the giants of the medical AI space. Learn from and contribute to an innovative fast developing field. Our remote first roles offer a lot of flexibility, and opportunities for growth within the startup framework.


Ready to apply? We value clarity, precision, and a bias for action. If this sounds like you, let's talk.

title: Data & Transportation Analyst - Advanced English
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Desenvolvedor Python
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend (Python) Sr.

Desenvolvedor experiente que construirá a espinha dorsal da aplicação, garantindo que os serviços de suporte ao assistente de IA sejam escaláveis, seguros e de alta performance.

Será responsável por desenhar a arquitetura de microsserviços, gerenciar bancos de dados e criar as APIs que conectarão o frontend e os agentes de IA com os sistemas de backend.


Habilidades e Conhecimentos Necessários:

Linguagens e Frameworks: Proficiência em Python (FastAPI, FastMCP, etc).

Arquitetura e Cloud: Sólida experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços, conteinerização (Docker, Kubernetes) e implantação em ambientes de nuvem (Openshift, AWS, GCP ou Azure).

Bancos de Dados: Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, DB2, etc) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, etc), incluindo modelagem de dados e otimização de consultas.

APIs e Mensageria: Expertise no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e integração MCP. Conhecimento em mensageria usando Kafka.

Boas Práticas: Domínio de Git, práticas de CI/CD e escrita de testes unitários e de integração. Metodologias: Experiência com metodologias ágeis.

Conhecimento mínimo em Java desejável.


100% REMOTA

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

#VemPraSIS #SomosSIS

title: People Business Partner
description:
This role is part of the People Success area and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.


What You'll Do:

  • Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.
  • Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.
  • Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams.
  • Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle.


What we expect from you:


  • Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred
  • 4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposure within tech companies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.
  • Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.
  • Previous experience with Workday is a plus.


Soft Skills

  • Clear, empathetic, and assertive communication.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • Strategic mindset with strong execution.
  • Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.
  • Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices.


What we offer:

  • Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.
  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
  • Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Design visually engaging websites using UI/UX best practices, accessibility standards, and performance guidelines in Figma.
  • Develop approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow and WordPress.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Use AI tools (Gemini, Claude) for web design, development, and prototyping.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Figma/Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing using Figma AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds.
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you!


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
⚠️ Important Application Notice

Please select only the role that best aligns with your experience. We will only review your first application. If you apply to multiple positions on LinkedIn, additional submissions will not be processed and may cause your application to be overlooked.


Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um(a) Sales Manager para atuar junto a um de nossos clientes do setor de Fabricação de produtos químicos. Esta é a função responsável por atingir os objetivos de receita junto à equipe de vendas em nível global, atuando na gestão de equipes, análise de mercado e definição de planos comerciais e de clientes.

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Idioma: Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Duração: Indeterminado

Responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar um plano de vendas internacional e metas (quotas) alinhadas ao plano operacional anual.
  • Gerenciar o desempenho de colaboradores individuais e/ou equipes dedicadas.
  • Analisar ativamente as tendências do mercado global para enfrentar desafios de forma eficiente e aproveitar oportunidades.
  • Manter margens de preço para atingir as metas de rentabilidade.
  • Garantir o mix de produtos com base em receita, volume e margens.
  • Garantir o mix de clientes com base no tipo de stakeholder, proporção de contribuição de receita e fatores de dependência.
  • Atingir metas de receita visando crescimento ideal ano a ano.
  • Monitorar o desempenho de pagamentos na carteira de clientes.
  • Desenvolver planos de aquisição e retenção de clientes para maximizar o valor do ciclo de vida do cliente (CLV).
  • Acompanhar a entrega de serviços técnicos dos produtos em toda a carteira de clientes.
  • Participar de programas de treinamento para equipes globais com base em análise de gaps de competências.
  • Realizar reportes periódicos de vendas e apresentações junto ao vice-presidente.
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas e proposição de ações em coordenação com o vice-presidente.
  • Trabalhar em outros projetos comerciais adicionais conforme designado.

Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente
  • Graduação em química, engenharia química ou áreas correlatas
  • Vivência na indústria química.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Administrator

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Duration: 6months

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Salesforce Administrator to manage, configure, and optimize our Salesforce platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring data integrity, automation efficiency, and user adoption.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce platform including user setup, profiles, roles, and permissions
  • Design and implement custom objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, and flows
  • Build and manage reports and dashboards for business insights
  • Automate business processes using Flow, Process Builder (legacy), and approval processes
  • Perform data management including imports, deduplication, and data quality monitoring
  • Support Sales, Service, and other cloud users with issue resolution and enhancements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and translate business requirements
  • Ensure system security, compliance, and best practices
  • Manage releases, change sets, and deployments
  • Provide user training and drive Salesforce adoption


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Salesforce configuration (Objects, Fields, Layouts)
  • Flow Builder (must-have)
  • Reports & Dashboards
  • Data Loader / Data Import Wizard
  • Understanding of Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud
  • Knowledge of security model (Profiles, Roles, Sharing Rules)
  • Experience with data quality and governance
  • Familiarity with integration concepts (REST/SOAP APIs – basic level)
  • Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills


Primary Skills

1.Salesforce Platform hands-on experience

2.Salesforce admin expertise (Security Model, Data Model, End to End configuration, Flows etc)

3. Salesforce Admin Cert

4. Reports & Dashboards – Handson


Secondary Skills

1. Sales Cloud, Service Cloud

2. Business analysis

3. Stakeholder Management

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

Apply Now

If you are passionate about data engineering and enjoy solving complex data challenges, we’d love to hear from you. Send to

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

title: SAP FI/CO (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP FI Specialist


Summary: Support and enhance Lubrizol Global SAP Procure to Pay (PTP) and Record to Report (RTR) process as a specialist,

with a primary focus on Procurement, Finance, Cost, Tax, and Localization solutions for Brazil and Mexico. Experience with CO.

Leverage deep knowledge of procurement and financial operations, tax calculation and compliance reporting within the Brazilian and Mexican legislative environments.

Engage with business stakeholders across the globe to ensure alignment and support across strategic priorities, technical domains, and standardized practices globally while ensuring that local and regional requirements are met.

Responsibilities:

Analyze, configure, test,deploy, and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions focused on PTP and RTR, especially as they relate to Procurement,

Finance, and Tax processes for Brazil and Mexico (including Nota Fiscal, CFDI, SPED, and related regulatory reporting).

Make recommendations for improving business processes and technology enablement, particularly around local tax compliance and statutory reporting.

Ensure accurate localization of SAP solutions to comply with Brazilian and Mexican legal and fiscal requirements, including tax calculation engines, e invoicing, and withholding tax management.

Develop standard business process design, configure, test, deploy and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions along with any bolt on for all procurement processes.

Effectively communicate and collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Business Partners, and Senior Leadership, as well as with other business stakeholders.

Resolve integration points between RTR, Procure to Pay (PTP), Order to Cash (OTC), and Treasury processes to ensure they are properly addressed.

Support daily operations for SAP Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes, including issue resolution, user support, and change management.

Makes decisions applicable to level of influence in the organization. Collaborate with cross functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

Utilize technical and functional expertise to support Procurement, Finance, and Tax initiatives.

Participate in or lead projects implementing or upgrading, tax localization, and compliance solutions.


Horario de trabalho: Comercial

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.


About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.
